checks.criterion: Product evidence remains more important than atmosphere.
checks.evidence: Glow and particles occupy more area than the interface.
checks.action: Remove atmospheric layers and enlarge the real interface.

checks.criterion: Optical alignment and macro crops are intentional.
checks.action: Capture and inspect representative full-size frames.

checks.criterion: The result avoids recognizable launch-film imitation.
checks.evidence: No exact third-party layout was reproduced.

identity_review.evidence: After labels and presenter are ignored, only dark gradients and interchangeable cards remain.

template_swap_test.evidence: The same cards and gradients can be reused by changing labels.

content_style_fit.evidence: The dark neon treatment is applied only because the subject is AI and conflicts with the trust-led case study.
content_style_fit.action: Re-route the video around evidence-led intelligence with a light neutral base and real workflow proof.

project_recognizability.evidence: The frames remain interchangeable with unrelated AI and productivity videos.
project_recognizability.action: Build a recurring content-specific transformation from real project evidence.

narrative_clarity.evidence: The scenes list features but do not build toward a clear result.
narrative_clarity.action: Reorder the scenes around one problem, one transformation, and one result.

composition_and_focus.evidence: Every scene repeats the same centered card stack.
composition_and_focus.action: Create an edge-anchored UI crop and vary scale at the structural contrast beat.

typography_system.evidence: Headlines and captions use similar size and weight.
typography_system.action: Define separate display, caption, and metadata roles.

image_and_material_treatment.evidence: Blue-purple glows are unrelated to the product source material.
image_and_material_treatment.action: Derive the palette from the product UI and remove unsupported decorative glows.

motion_and_rhythm.evidence: All scenes have equal duration and identical upward fades.
motion_and_rhythm.action: Lengthen the result reveal and define movement hierarchy before implementation.

continuity_and_distinctiveness.evidence: The video is consistent but visually interchangeable with generic AI promos.
continuity_and_distinctiveness.action: Introduce one content-specific crop and annotation motif.
